The stun lasts for 3-4 seconds. }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Fallen Guardian''' is a large guardian [[Enemies|enemy]] that appears in the [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] exclusive [[Legacy Fallen Mode|Legacy Fallen]] mode. Although it could not spawn naturally in [[The Classic Event]], the [[Fallen King (Legacy)|Fallen King]] could summon the '''Fallen Guardian''' during ''Rage Mode''. The '''Fallen Guardian''' always spawns just before the [[Fallen King (Legacy)|Fallen King]] and [[Void Reaver (Legacy)|Void Reaver]] (it also used to appear before the [[Nuclear Fallen King]] spawns). It also appears when the [[Fallen King (Legacy)|Fallen King]] (and formerly the [[Nuclear Fallen King]]) summons them during ''Rage Mode''. It also appeared in the legacy [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Hidden Wave]] and [[The Classic Event]] before its removal. The '''Fallen Guardian''' is an extremely difficult enemy to defeat due to its high health (far higher than the [[Summoner Boss]] and [[Slow King (Legacy)|Slow King]]) and below average walkspeed. Additionally, it has a defense of 80%, meaning that the damage capabilities of most towers are reduced drastically. On top of that, the '''Fallen Guardian''' has the ability to thrust its spear at towers, stunning them for a period of time. The '''Fallen Guardian''' is replaced by the [[Nuclear Guardian]] in [[Polluted Wasteland II]], the [[Cavalry]] in [[Badlands II]] and the [[Minigunner (Pizza Party)|Minigunner]] in [[Pizza Party]]. ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Current |The current '''Fallen Guardian''' is similar to its original version, except it dominus is now dark turquoise. It is now also right-handed and has a twisted left leg. Its neon parts are now light purple. |Original |The original '''Fallen Guardian''' had black reflective skin. It wore dark turquoise granite armor, which comprised of armbands, knee-pads, sleeves and chestplate. It had black granite gloves, its torso was dark turquoise granite, and it wielded a spear with purple halos near the head. It also wore a black marble dominus. On its dominus, there were parts which were neon purple. Purple smoke was emitted from their torso. }} ==Strategy== *Deal with the '''Fallen Guardian''' before moving on to the major boss that it spawns in front of. With high health, faster speed, the ability to stun towers and extremely high defense, the '''Fallen Guardian''' protects the major boss and can overwhelm poorly prepared defenses. *As the '''Fallen Guardian''' has quite high defense, defense dropping towers like the [[Freezer]], [[Pyromancer]] or [[Jester]] can be quite useful at dropping it. Some towers, like the [[Freezer]], [[Frost Blaster]] or [[Toxic Gunner]] can also be useful at slowing it down. **However, freezing towers and [[Warden]] can only freeze or stun the '''Fallen Guardian''' for a shorter period of time due to its size. ***Because of its [[Stun Immunity]], stunning towers like the [[Electroshocker]] can only slow it down instead of stopping it completely while knockback towers cannot knock it back. ***Having a concentrated group of [[Sledger]]s may be able to impede '''Fallen Guardians'''. *The [[Accelerator]], [[Ranger]], [[Engineer]], [[Golden Minigunner]] and [[Pursuit]] are excellent towers against the '''Fallen Guardian''' due to their high DPS. **The [[Commander]] can decrease the firerate of these towers, especially with its ''Call to Arms'' ability. **The [[Ranger]] and [[Pursuit]] can be very useful, as they cannot be stunned. **Be aware that if the [[Accelerator]] is stunned by the '''Fallen Guardian''', it will have to charge up again. **While the [[Engineer]] can be stunned, its sentries cannot be damaged by the '''Fallen Guardian''', making it great against this enemy. *If you can, try not to clump towers close together, as they will all be stunned by the '''Fallen Guardian''' with one thrust of its spear. **It is best to place towers a distance away from the path so that they cannot get stunned. *Splash damage towers, like the [[Mortar]] and [[Rocketeer]], can be useful against the '''Fallen Guardian''', as they spawn in groups and splash damage ignores defense, dealing full damage to the '''Fallen Guardian'''. **You should not rely on these towers to kill '''Fallen Guardians''', as they do not have enough DPS to deal with '''Fallen Guardians''' alone. *You can use the [[Medic]]'s ability to shield towers from the '''Fallen Guardian's''' stun. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants}} FallenGuardian-0.png|First version (13 October 2019 – 29 October 2020) IndexLegacyFallenGuardian.png|'''Fallen Guardian''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *Prior to the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]], the '''Fallen Guardian''' did not have partial electric immunity, unlike the [[Gold Guard]]. **While the [[Gold Guard]] was immune to the effects of the [[Freezer]] and [[Frost Blaster]], the '''Fallen Guardian''' is not. *The '''Fallen Guardian's''' appearance is similar to the [[w:c:roblox-tower-battles:Guardian|Guardian]] from ''Tower Battles''. **The '''Fallen Guardian''' was the only enemy in the [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|legacy Hidden Wave]] that was not an enemy exclusive to the [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Hidden Wave]] or an event enemy. ==Update History== {{Scroll|text= *'''13 October 2019''' -
